stories.title: Andoni Iraola urges Liverpool players to go down after unpunished shirt tug in Arsenal defeat
stories.details: Liverpool suffered a 1-0 defeat against Arsenal at Anfield, with their performance described as a work in progress against the champions. Following an incident where Alexander Isak suffered a blatant shirt tug that went unpunished, Andoni Iraola stated he will instruct his Liverpool squad to go down to try to win penalties in the future.

stories.title: World No 4 Ben Shelton set to hire coach Juan Carlos Ferrero
stories.details: World No 4 tennis player Ben Shelton is set to appoint Juan Carlos Ferrero as his coach. The decision concludes months of speculation regarding who Carlos Alcaraz's former mentor would train next on the tour.

stories.title: Antonelli captures Formula One title in emotional victory
stories.details: Antonelli secured the Formula One championship title following an emotional conclusion to the season. Overcome with emotion after the race, Antonelli admitted, 'I’ve cried way too much today.'

stories.title: Andreas Almgren and Sheila Chepkirui win New York City Marathon
stories.details: Sweden's Andreas Almgren clinched victory in the men's division of the New York City Marathon. In the women's race, Sheila Chepkirui of Kenya crossed the line first to claim the marathon title.

stories.title: Paul O’Connell praises 'big leader' Tadhg Furlong ahead of Argentina clash
stories.details: Paul O’Connell praised Tadhg Furlong as a 'big leader' as Ireland prepares to host Argentina in international rugby. The Irish coaching staff highlighted Furlong's influence as a central component of their preparations for the upcoming test match.

stories.title: Wayne Rooney proposes unusual solution to Manchester United's struggles
stories.details: Wayne Rooney has put forward an unconventional strategy to address the ongoing problems facing Manchester United. The proposal arrives amid wider discussions surrounding Premier League tactics, club form, and managerial choices.

stories.title: Irish Olympian and European champion Ciara Mageean dies aged 34
stories.details: Irish Olympian and European champion Ciara Mageean has died at the age of 34. The middle-distance runner's passing marks a significant loss for Irish athletics, where she was widely celebrated for her track achievements.

stories.title: Binance co-founder warns of scams as customers withdraw billions after $6.3bn hack
stories.details: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao warned that scammers are in 'overdrive' targeting customers following a record $6.3bn hack attributed by experts to North Korea. After phased reopening of withdrawals, the platform recorded $4.6bn in withdrawals against $1bn in deposits, producing a net outflow of roughly $3.6bn from its $171bn in assets under management. Derive.xyz chief executive Nick Forster noted that US spot bitcoin ETFs also registered $643m in net outflows on the first trading session after the breach.

stories.title: Chainalysis targeted by cyber-attack amid heightened crypto security concerns
stories.details: Trading platform Chainalysis revealed that it was the target of a cyber-attack but confirmed no unauthorized access was detected regarding session tokens, authentication credentials, or investigation content. The company stated it is working alongside cybersecurity specialists to harden its infrastructure. Chainalysis confirmed the incident was entirely unrelated to the theft at Binance.

stories.title: Major oil companies on track to share more than $95bn in quarterly profits
stories.details: Nine major global oil companies are projected to share more than $95bn in profit across two consecutive quarters. The elevated earnings come as global energy markets continue to deliver substantial financial returns for multinational energy producers.

stories.title: National Grid to site UK's biggest electricity substation near Teesside datacentre
stories.details: National Grid announced plans to locate the United Kingdom's largest electricity substation in Teesside. The major infrastructure installation is planned adjacent to a proposed regional datacentre to accommodate substantial industrial power needs.

stories.title: Heritage fashion brand John Smedley innovates amid challenging market
stories.details: Heritage knitwear manufacturer John Smedley is pursuing operational and design innovations to navigate difficult retail trading conditions. The brand is balancing long-standing manufacturing traditions with evolving commercial pressures.

stories.title: Disheartened youth embrace short-term spending amid economic uncertainty
stories.details: Young consumers feeling increasingly pessimistic about their economic prospects and financial future are choosing to spend money on immediate experiences rather than saving. Under the sentiment of being 'doomed anyway,' many report prioritizing present gratification over long-term financial milestones.

stories.title: Millions of UK homeowners brace to remortgage on worse terms
stories.details: Millions of households in the United Kingdom are preparing to remortgage their properties on significantly less favorable terms as borrowing rates climb. The anticipated payment jumps are expected to strain household finances across the country.

theme: UK & Irish Politics and Public Policy

stories.title: Alan Milburn review urges local drive and tough love approach to youth unemployment
stories.details: A government review into youth unemployment led by Alan Milburn will recommend a decentralized 'tough love approach' directing combined and local authorities to move benefit recipients into work. Supported by upfront Treasury funding, the system proposes a youth guarantee model ensuring every young person is offered a job, training, or an apprenticeship, while school career planning could begin at age 14.

stories.title: UK willing to spend £450m a year on EU student fees to join Made in Europe scheme
stories.details: The UK government has indicated a willingness to commit £450m annually to subsidize European Union university students by matching domestic tuition rates. British officials noted that this financial concession remains contingent on securing UK entry into the EU's flagship Made in Europe industrial programme.

stories.title: MPs warn UK is improvising China trade policy without long-term strategy
stories.details: Members of Parliament have issued warnings that the UK government is making up its policy toward China 'as it goes along.' Lawmakers expressed concern that ministers lack a coherent economic framework balancing trade engagements against security risks.

stories.title: Home secretary plans 10-year settlement waiting periods for some migrants
stories.details: The UK home secretary is preparing immigration rules that will require certain migrants to wait 10 years or more before becoming eligible for permanent settlement. The measure forms part of broader governmental efforts to tighten settlement criteria.

stories.title: Irish trade unions consider strike escalation as pay talks collapse
stories.details: Trade unions in Ireland are evaluating an escalation of strike action after negotiations with the government broke down over public pay disparities. Although efforts to jump-start discussions are scheduled for Tuesday, union leadership insisted that ministers have yet to present a credible pay offer.

stories.title: Healey vows to veto offshore wind projects that fail to reduce energy bills
stories.details: Energy policy announcements indicate that Healey will veto new offshore wind developments if they do not lead directly to lower electricity bills for consumers. The measure aims to align future green infrastructure projects with domestic affordability objectives.

stories.title: More than 830,000 low-income UK families excluded from £100 cost of living payment
stories.details: New financial analysis revealed that over 830,000 lower-income British families will fail to qualify for the government's £100 cost of living support payment. Campaigners have raised concerns over gaps in welfare eligibility as living costs persist.

stories.title: Democratic Representative Haley Stevens endorses Republican Senate candidate Mike Rogers
stories.details: Democratic congresswoman Haley Stevens announced her endorsement of Republican nominee Mike Rogers over Democrat Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan's high-stakes US Senate race. The rare show of party disunity just days before the midterm election drew attention on the campaign trail, prompting Donald Trump to publicly praise Stevens during a rally in Iowa.

stories.title: Senate control hangs in balance as Democrats lead key battleground polls
stories.details: Final polling ahead of the US midterms shows Democratic candidates ahead of Republicans across almost all seven key battleground states that will decide control of the Senate. With conservative states such as Iowa and Kansas growing unexpectedly competitive, Donald Trump visited both states in a late campaigning push.

stories.title: Trump administration pursues Russian energy deals and sanctions relief in push to end Ukraine war
stories.details: The Donald Trump administration is aggressively exploring economic incentives to encourage Vladimir Putin to negotiate an end to the war in Ukraine, with efforts spearheaded by business negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner. Proposals have included a US-led consortium buying Lukoil international assets, waiving sanctions on Russian diesel, and considering sanctions relief for Moscow's flagship government investment fund. Analysts caution that Putin is accepting concessions without making compromises, pointing to the failure of Germany's historical Ostpolitik trade policy.

stories.title: Elon Musk spends $446m on US midterm election campaigns
stories.details: Campaign finance records reveal that Elon Musk has contributed $446m toward the US midterm elections. The spending underscores the unprecedented scale of private capital deployed to influence closely contested federal races.

stories.title: Nine killed in private plane crash near Donald Trump's Florida resort
stories.details: A private jet crashed on the edge of a mobile home park in Florida, killing nine people on board. The fatal crash occurred approximately six miles away from Donald Trump's resort.

stories.title: German government vows crackdown on rioters after interior minister blames extremists and migrants
stories.details: Germany's federal government promised a severe crackdown on rioters following weekend street unrest. The interior minister attributed the violence to left-wing groups and migrants, prompting national debates on policing and civil order.

stories.title: The King told Commonwealth partnerships require hearing voices of small states
stories.details: The King was told during Commonwealth discussions that the voices of small member states must be heard to establish genuine, lasting partnerships. The diplomatic exchange comes amid ongoing deliberations among Commonwealth leadership over institutional representation and historic equity.
